crosswalk.description: Directional crosswalk from ref-scheme-1 onto ref-scheme-2. Composing it gives a Context two schemes, so the server-slice plans can mark in the one that is not primary. LOW and HIGH carry; MED has no counterpart and is forbidden.

mappings.reason: Low is low in both schemes.
High is high in both schemes.
